findings.text: batchUpdate copy-pastes series/authors update orchestration from updateMedia (media.updateFromRequest → updateSeriesFromRequest → filter-data add → updateAuthorsFromRequest), differing only in aggregating removed ids — ~30 near-duplicate lines per item in two live paths, already drifting on cron handling.

getAll/create return raw Sequelize JSON including authHeaderValue, while the model's toClientJson contract explicitly excludes it ('Safe for clients', models/CustomMetadataProvider.js:96); routes are admin-gated but inconsistent with the model contract.
LibraryController 1500 lines (~30 endpoints), LibraryItemController 1251 (~28); cohesive-by-resource rather than god-file, but heavy single files.
encodeM4b log lines use wrong tag '[MiscController]' (copy-paste from another controller) — cosmetic.
updateMedia reuses uploadCover via `await LibraryItemController.prototype.uploadCover.bind(this)(req,res,false)` — awkward prototype-bind hack; deserves a private helper.
scan and batchQuickMatch respond 200 then run long work after the response; failures surface only via socket events/logs — deliberate fire-and-forget, but unreported errors.
